subject: Commercial route decision + procurement checkpoint (PO vs marketplace)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Jill Turner <jill.turner@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo recap + procurement path questions

Thanks for the call this morning — good to meet the Acme Health team. Quick written recap and a couple of asks so procurement can move forward cleanly:

- Summary: You liked Redwood's latency profile and the idea of Dedicated capacity for the initial pilot (HIT-Search).
- Procurement question to confirm: will you be pursuing a standard PO with your AP team or would you prefer marketplace procurement (Azure Marketplace) so billing is automated?
- Legal/commercial: Team asked for a draft SOW and a high-level MSA redline. I've attached a draft SOW and a short SOC 2 summary for your security reviewers.
- Next actions I propose: 1) procurement confirms PO vs marketplace path and billing contact; 2) we share the pricing spreadsheet and sample invoice; 3) we schedule a 30-minute procurement walkthrough (if helpful).

Attachments: Redwood_Draft_SOW.pdf (draft SOW), Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf

If you can flag which route you prefer by EOD Monday, we’ll align the internal commercial approvers and prepare the right paperwork.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0119

From: Jill Turner <jill.turner@acmehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + procurement path questions

Thanks Vanessa — useful recap. Quick answers and a couple of asks from procurement: 

- Preference: Our AP team prefers PO for enterprise vendors, but we are exploring Azure Marketplace for cloud-native pieces. For this pilot, PO is likely simpler for our internal tracking.
- Procurement needs: Please send a pricing table with list/discount lines and a sample invoice (we need the invoice format to map to our ERPs). Also procurement will need a vendor risk file (VRF) or security packet in addition to the SOC 2 summary.
- Timeline: Our internal procurement review is queued this week; decision expected by end of next week if paperwork is correct.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept a PO and issue invoices to our billing contact (accounts.payable@acmehealth.com), and whether you support Azure Marketplace in case we change path?

Jill Turner
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Health
jill.turner@acmehealth.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Jill Turner <jill.turner@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + procurement path questions

Great — thanks for the clarity, Jill. Short answers and the next steps: 

- PO vs Card: We accept both PO (net-30/60 on enterprise contracts) and card for smaller subscriptions. For this engagement we can route through PO.
- Marketplace: We do offer Azure Marketplace and GCP Marketplace subscriptions; if you choose that route, billing will be through the marketplace and provisioning is automated, but contract/terms vary on marketplace purchases.
- Deliverables attached: pricing spreadsheet (pricing included inline below), sample invoice (Sample-Invoice-Acme.xlsx), and the SOC 2 summary you already have. I’ve uploaded the proposed MSA to DocuSign for faster signatures: https://app.docusign.com/documents/ABC12345

Pricing highlights (pilot):
- Dedicated pilot (4 GPUs): list $18,000/month, proposed 12% pilot discount => $15,840/month
- On-demand overage rate TBD (will be capped per the SOW)

Next steps I recommend:
1) Procurement confirms PO billing contact and desired payment terms (net-30 vs net-60)
2) We provision a redline-ready MSA and SOW for your legal review (DocuSign link above)
3) If helpful, schedule a 30-minute procurement + IT risk call to walk through the VRF packet and data residency.

I’ll hold the proposed pricing through the end of next week while we confirm the route.

—Vanessa

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 07:15:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: payment terms and approval path

Vanessa / Ethan — quick note: we can offer net-60 for ACME-149 at enterprise scale. If they request net-60 on the PO, finance will need the signed MSA and a billing contact + remit address on the PO. Please make sure the PO includes the billing email (accounts.payable@acmehealth.com) and that the purchase amount maps to the invoice sample attached.

Also flagging: if they go marketplace, different reconciliation process — need to push the marketplace SKU list to finance before procurement signs.

Karthik
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Jill Turner <jill.turner@acmehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + procurement path questions

Thanks all. Procurement ran into two items that are holding the PO: 

1) Security paperwork: procurement needs a completed vendor risk form (VRF) — can you provide the VRF PDF and a brief note on data residency for the Dedicated environment (we need to confirm all customer data stays in US regions).
2) Invoice mapping: we tried the sample invoice you supplied and need one column adjusted (please include a "billing reference" field that we can map to our ERP).

If you can send the VRF and an updated sample invoice with the billing reference by EOD tomorrow, procurement will proceed to approvals. If not, can we do a 30-minute call tomorrow to clear these items?

I’ll await the updated docs.

Best,
Jill
